desc: Implement the off-P second-walk formula solution and make the three samples pass.
Replace the E2 endpoint-gadget logic with the corrected endpoint-buffer rule (generalized BFS with 4r+4), keep E1, and answer = 2*d + min(E1, E2).
Stress-test the corrected solution against exact state-space BFS for all connected simple graphs up to N=6 and random connected graphs up to N=8; fix any counterexample.
Verify O(N+M) time and memory for N,M=2e5 (path/cycle/star/random graphs).
Confirm no additional block-cut/bridge characterization is needed; current formula covers all cases.
